title: HumanTOMATO: Text-aligned Whole-body Motion Generation - Microsoft Research
abstract: This work targets a novel text-driven whole-body motion generation task, which takes a given textual description as input and aims at generating high-quality, diverse, and coherent facial expressions, hand gestures, and body motions simultaneously.
